mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_fact (tenant_id, device_resource_id, fact_type, fact_value, state_version, observed_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceResourceId}, #{factType}, #{factValue}, #{stateVersion}, CAST(#{observedAt} AS timestamptz)) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_resource_id, fact_type) DO UPDATE SET fact_value = EXCLUDED.fact_value, state_version = EXCLUDED.state_version, observed_at = EXCLUDED.observed_at, updated_at = now()
